observations.detail: Bottom-left icon opened the native Settings page at Models & Providers.
Models & Providers > Add Provider opened the provider dialog. Import API key file opened the native picker. Picker and dialog were canceled without selecting a file or entering a key.

Top-right titlebar X closed the main window. Immediate native-window enumeration returned no ADE window; subsequent process enumeration returned no ADE.exe process.
